why: UNIVERSES: all eighteen theorems of A at universe 0 (paracompactSpace_of_isProperMap at 0,0). The two statements differ in the compactness clause (4): A's proposition_17_8_16_four assumes a proper covering uniformizer at every point of supp Θ (unif_hyp: F(β) nonempty when Θ(β) > 0, the text's 'we take a proper covering uniformizer around β'), while B's (4) has no such hypothesis, and neither the project's ProperPolyfoldCoveringStructure nor PolyfoldConstruction asks F(β) to be nonempty. not_B is proved: the trivial groupoid on ℕ with |A| = ℕ discrete, |B| = ℕ topologized as {0} ∪ {1/n} ⊆ ℝ (compact), P = id (a proper covering functor in the sense of Definition 17.8.1: continuous, bijective, evenly covered with U = univ), the empty uniformizer construction and the empty polyfold structure, Θ = 1; then |supp Θ| is compact in |B| and |supp(Θ ∘ P)| = ℕ is not compact in |A|. Hence A → B does not hold and B → A holds only vacuously. On the other clauses A gives B (A_to_Bpart proved: branched, (1) manifold-type, (2) orbifold-type, (3) tameness), and there A is more general, being stated for any proper covering uniformizer construction F, not only for one carrying a polyfold covering structure.
B_issue: B's clause (4) omits the existence of a proper covering uniformizer at the points of supp Θ, which the text's proof uses ('we take a proper covering uniformizer around β') and which the text's notion of polyfold structure presupposes; the formal vocabulary B builds on (ProperPolyfoldCoveringStructure, PolyfoldConstruction) allows F(β) = ∅, so B's (4) does not hold as written (not_B). With the hypothesis ∀ β, 0 < Θ β → (Pc.S.toC.F β).Nonempty added to (4), B's (4) is exactly A's proposition_17_8_16_four.
overlap: rt_overlap B_to_A: 586 shared project theorems; all come from the statement of A (the proof fields of the M-polyfold and sheet-construction vocabulary its types mention), since B_to_A is not_B followed by elimination of the contradiction and not_B uses only the groupoid/functor/structure definitions and Mathlib topology. All #rt_check calls pass (A_to_Bpart, main_to_Bbranched, not_B, B_to_A).

main.note: Compared with B's branched clause (the clause this conjunct states): main_to_Bbranched is proved. The converse is not derivable: B's clause speaks only of constructions F that carry a full proper polyfold covering structure (a polyfold structure of B on the Ψ and M-polyfold structures on the M(Ψ̂, Ψ̂')), while the main conjunct holds for every proper covering uniformizer construction F; recovering it from B would need building those structures for an arbitrary F. Against the whole of B (which does not hold) the main conjunct gives no implication and B ⇒ main is vacuous.
